answer: A meadow stays diverse only if each plant holds real ground, so our network requires every identity to lock a refundable bond that grows with each new account from the same operator. Like vines sharing one trellis, linked identities are traced through funding sources, and a single thread of common control raises the total stake required. Forging a crowd then costs more locked capital than honest participation earns, and proven sybil clusters forfeit the bond entirely.
